observables.question: At contact, is the hitting upper arm touching the side of the body, or is there a visible gap?
Between the ball leaving the machine and contact, does the player take small adjusting steps?
Player's spoken one-word result after the shot
At contact, is the hitting elbow clearly bent or nearly straight?

nodes.name: contact too close to the body

differentials.discriminator: OBS-05=several but still touching -> spacing set-up, not footwork

nodes.test10: 5 balls normal + 5 balls starting half a step wider; count 'crowded' callouts
nodes.next_one_thing: 让球在锥桶外侧被击中

nodes.name: no adjusting steps, walks straight at the ball

differentials.discriminator: OBS-02=gap -> footwork alone is not causing crowding

nodes.test10: 10 balls with two small steps after the machine fires; compare callouts
nodes.next_one_thing: 球出机后先让脚动两下再挥
